_note: Public TOON devnet on Linode. Committed SAMPLE (placeholder DOMAIN). On the live host, devnet.sh regenerates this from .env. Peers point a TOON node/SDK at these URLs (chainRpcUrls / EVM_RPC_URL).

solana._fund: infra/solana/fund-solana.sh <pubkey> — airdrops SOL + transfers mock USDC from the treasury

mina._fund: infra/mina/fund-mina-usdc.sh <b58> [usdc] — admin-mints USDC on the public devnet
mina._note: Passthrough proxy of the PUBLIC Mina devnet (no node). The USDC token zkApp is deployed ONCE to public devnet by tools/mina/deploy-usdc-token.ts; tokenAddress/tokenId here are PLACEHOLDERS — replace with the live deploy output.

connector._note: App-behind-connector (issue #222): present only when COMPOSE_PROFILES includes `app`. POST a paid ILP PREPARE (with an ILP-Payment-Channel-Claim header) to ilpUrl; free Nostr reads hit relayWsUrl directly. EVM-only settlement on this box's anvil. The relay paid-write store port and the connector admin API are NOT public.

_decimalsNote: USDC is 6-decimal on every chain (EVM + Solana), so claim base units are uniform — no cross-chain normalization needed.
